culprit_citations.quoted_text: AWP Group Holdings, Inc. | (6) | First Lien Debt (Delayed Draw) | S + 4.50 % | 8.22 | % | 12/23/2030 | 629 | 625 | 623 | 0.04 | %

findings.detail: The source % of Net Assets column ties to reported total net assets of 1,388,129 thousand, not to total investments fair value of 2,155,846 thousand used by the flag context.

rationale: Source rows decide the question. The filing reports total net assets of 1,388,129 thousand. All4 Buyer delayed draw has fair value 486 thousand and prints 0.04% of net assets; 486 / 1,388,129 * 100 = 0.0350%, which rounds to 0.04%. AWP delayed draw has fair value 623 thousand and prints 0.04%; 623 / 1,388,129 * 100 = 0.0449%, also rounding to 0.04%. The flagged identity failures therefore reflect a bad/internal denominator anchor, not bad source percentages.
